introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - Advanced Level Examination. Information and Communication Technologies (0796), Paper 3 (practical), June 2025. Duration: two hours. Answer ALL tasks.**

The booklet reproduced here contains three versions of the same practical paper, headed Group 1, Group 2 and Group 3 (booklets 00/0796/3/G1, G2 and G3): each version has the same three tasks (Task A: Database, 20 marks; Task B: Spreadsheet, 17 marks; Task C: Presentation, 13 marks) with different data, names and cell references.

Enter the information required in the shaded boxes. Do not write in pencil. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answer. Your results must be recorded in the spaces provided in this question booklet. Candidates must allow for themselves enough time to complete and check their work where these are required. The supervisor will guide you on how to save your files but usually you will be expected to save all your work in one folder named *Candidate folder* that will be created in your desktop. When an imperative programming language is require to write program code, either Standard [ISO] Pascal or [ANSI] C programming language may be used. You should ensure all your work is collected and printed before leaving the examination room. All printed work should be inserted in this booklet and well stapled. Carefully handle all equipment put at your disposal to avoid accidents that may lead to a disaster or system failure. Report any case of system or device malfunction to your supervisor.

The working files (the workbooks Trift_Loan, Customer_Loan and Worker_Loan, one per group) are supplied on the day in the Candidate folder; they are not reproduced in the printed paper.

**GROUP 1 - TASK C: PRESENTATION (13 MARKS)**

You are required to use the appropriate software tools to create the content of the presentation slide as shown below.

![fig-1](gce-al-ict-2025-p3-officiel-cameroun_exercice_G1-C_fig_1.png)

The table of the slide, as printed:

| SCHOOL | HISTORY | GEOGRAPHY | CHEMISTRY |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| GBHS KUMBA | 52 | 34 | 18 |
| GBHS YAOUNDE | 142 | 95 | 99 |
| BGS BUEA | 104 | 152 | 83 |

The title of the slide is of font type ALGERIAN and size 54. The content of the table is of font type Calibri (Body) and size 18.

You will be evaluated as follows:

figures.legende: Presentation slide to reproduce: title NATIONAL CONTEST, a 4 x 4 table (SCHOOL, HISTORY, GEOGRAPHY, CHEMISTRY) and a 3-D clustered column chart of the table data.

Chacune compte les tâches A (base de données, 20 points), B (tableur, 17 points) et C (présentation, 13 points). Elles sont transcrites en neuf fichiers : numero_exercice G1-A, G1-B, G1-C, G2-A... Le sujet n'impose ni la mise en page exacte ni les couleurs du graphique ; le corrigé décrit la procédure PowerPoint (non testée). Le recadrage conserve un peu de texte parasite de la face arrière du scan (transparence du papier), sans lien avec le sujet.

Group 1, tâche C : le titre de la diapositive est « NATIONAL CONTEST » en police Algerian taille 54 ; le graphique affiche les colonnes en 3-D (profondeur légère), l'axe vertical va de 0 à 160 par pas de 20.

Les barèmes détaillés (« Marking ») des corrigés sont des propositions : le sujet n'imprime que les points par question (et, pour la tâche C, les quatre critères d'évaluation). Les zones de réponse du livret (lignes pointillées, tableau des clés, cadre du schéma E-R) ne sont pas reproduites : elles sont signalées dans les énoncés. Les filigranes de gcerevision.com, les cadres d'en-tête et les artefacts de scanner sont ignorés.

questions.corrige_markdown:
The slide has a title at the top and, under it, two objects (a table and a chart) that are inserted by hand. The suitable layout is **Title Only** (Home > Layout > *Title Only*): it gives a title placeholder and leaves the rest of the slide free for the table and the chart. *Title and Content* is also accepted if the table is inserted in the content placeholder and the chart is added as a second object; a layout with a different structure (Title Slide, Two Content, Blank...) does not match the picture, where the table sits above the chart and both are centred under the title.

*Marking:* 1 mark for a layout with a title placeholder and room for the two objects, 1 mark for a slide where the title, the table and the chart are stacked, inside the slide and not overlapping.

Type the title **NATIONAL CONTEST** in the title placeholder (capital letters, as in the picture). Select it and, on the **Home** tab, choose the font **ALGERIAN** in the *Font* box and the size **54** in the *Font Size* box. The title is centred at the top of the slide, on one line (if the title wraps onto two lines at that size, widen the placeholder rather than reduce the size, because the size is imposed).

*Marking:* 1 mark for the title text typed correctly and centred, 1 mark for the font type ALGERIAN AND the size 54.

Insert > *Table* > 4 columns x 4 rows (one header row and three rows of data). Type the content exactly as in the slide:

| SCHOOL | HISTORY | GEOGRAPHY | CHEMISTRY |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| GBHS KUMBA | 52 | 34 | 18 |
| GBHS YAOUNDE | 142 | 95 | 99 |
| BGS BUEA | 104 | 152 | 83 |

Select the whole table (click a cell, then Ctrl + A) and set the font **Calibri (Body)** and the size **18** (Home > Font); the header row in bold; the numbers centred in their cells; visible borders on all the cells (Table Design > Borders > *All Borders*); the table placed under the title, inside the slide, with a width close to the one of the chart (if size 18 makes the rows too tall, reduce the cell margins rather than the font size, which is imposed).

*Marking:* 1 mark for the structure (4 x 4) and the correct data, 1 mark for the font Calibri (Body) at size 18, 1 mark for the formatting (header, alignment, borders, position).

questions.enonce_markdown: Chart type creation and organisation of chart elements *[6 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Insert > *Chart* > **Column** > **3-D Clustered Column** (the picture shows 3-D columns grouped by history, geography and chemistry). In the data sheet that opens (Excel), type the table of the slide, the first cell being left empty:

|  | HISTORY | GEOGRAPHY | CHEMISTRY |
|---|---|---|---|
| GBHS KUMBA | 52 | 34 | 18 |
| GBHS YAOUNDE | 142 | 95 | 99 |
| BGS BUEA | 104 | 152 | 83 |

The **series** (legend entries) are the three schools (GBHS KUMBA, GBHS YAOUNDE, BGS BUEA) and the **categories** (horizontal axis) are the three subjects (history, geography, chemistry): if the chart shows the opposite, use *Chart Design > Switch Row/Column*. Chart elements to organise so as to reproduce the picture: no chart title; **legend on the right** (Chart Elements > Legend > Right); vertical (value) axis from 0 to 160 with a major unit of 20; horizontal major gridlines; category labels under the columns; no data labels; the chart placed under the table, inside the slide and not overlapping the table.

*Marking:* 2 marks for the chart type (3-D clustered column), 2 marks for the data (the right series and categories, values equal to the table), 2 marks for the chart elements (legend, axis, gridlines, no title) and the position on the slide.
